reports.title: CN Delivers Strong Third Quarter Performance

guidance.heading: 2026 financial guidance (1)(2)
section: The Company continues to assume to deliver low single-digit RTM growth in 2026. The Company continues to expect adjusted diluted EPS growth in the mid-to-high single-digit range and is currently tracking more towards the upper end of this range.

In 2026, CN is still on track to invest approximately C$2.8 billion in its capital program, net of amounts reimbursed by customers. The Company also expects to continue improving its free cash flow conversion throughout 2026.
